target.title: feat(stepfun): add video understanding (describeVideo) support
target.body:
Adds native video understanding for Step 3.7 Flash via `describeVideo`.

## What
New `media-understanding-provider.ts` for the stepfun extension, following the moonshot pattern:
- `describeStepfunVideo` calls `https://api.stepfun.ai/v1/chat/completions` with standard `video_url` payload
- Step Plan endpoints (`/step_plan/v1`) are automatically redirected to the standard API
- Default video model: `step-3.7-flash`
- Auth: Bearer token from existing stepfun provider config

## Files
- `extensions/stepfun/media-understanding-provider.ts` — new
- `extensions/stepfun/index.ts` — registers provider

## Verified
- Tested locally via `openclaw infer video describe` with MP4 input (128MB / 5min limits per StepFun docs)

Closes video understanding gap for StepFun models in OpenClaw.
